objective: Clarify the meta route so Ron OS provides context, provenance, and routing to authoritative current sources without implying that the repository itself owns every mutable fact.

role_dispositions.destination: Meta mode states that Ron OS supplies context/provenance and routing to authoritative current sources rather than universal current truth.
Claim-class authority and stronger live/current sources remain unchanged.
Ordinary runtime routing remains unchanged outside explicit meta mode.
Existing meta-mode guard is updated to enforce the clarified source wording.
Candidate branch and Git history preserve the pre-change behavior.

capability_probes.assertion: Meta mode does not imply that the repository itself is the strongest source for every mutable claim.
Ordinary state-dependent requests keep existing routing.
Stronger live/current sources retain authority for mutable claims.
The wording clarification does not broaden action permissions.
Pre-change behavior remains recoverable from Git history.

tests.command: python3 tests/architecture_change_guard.py && python3 tests/architecture_change_guard_selftest.py && python3 tests/continuity_coverage_guard.py && python3 tests/continuity_coverage_guard_selftest.py
